newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers higher on cold weather.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers higher on cold weather.

text.p: North American bunker prices were higher this week amid forecasts for cold weather, strong NYMEX crude oil futures and good demand, players said.
In New York Harbor, spot 380 CST on Thursday was up $2 to between $134 and $135 a tonne, with spot 180 CST also up $1 to $137/139.
Players said the steady climb upward looks like it will last into next week due to the gain in NYMEX crude oil futures and cold weather forecast throughout much of the U.S.
The high number of inquiries earlier in the week had also translated into buys on Wednesday and Thursday in New York.
